name: Data deserialization with Confluent schema registry in Eventstream connector
description: When data in a Confluent Cloud for Apache Kafka topic is encoded using Confluent Schema Registry, it cannot be previewed, processed, or routed in Eventstream. This feature enables the Confluent Cloud for Apache Kafka streaming connector to access the Schema Registry, allowing the data to be deserialized as it flows into Eventstream

result.nameEs: Deserialización con el registro de esquemas de Confluent en el conector de Eventstream
